name: git-rail
description: Visualize Git history with stable branch rails that are easy to follow from top to bottom.

gitRail.maxCommits.description: Maximum number of commits shown in the branch map.

gitRail.includeLocalBranches.description: Include local branches as separate rails.

gitRail.includeRemoteBranches.description: Include remote-tracking branches as separate rails.

gitRail.hideEmptyBranches.description: Hide branches that have no commits of their own (e.g. fully merged branches).

gitRail.maxBranchLabelWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels of a branch label before it is truncated with an ellipsis.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/git.js && node --check src/layout.js && node --test test/*.test.js
